description: ai-ecoverse/slicc-jsh#1082: Node 22.22.0's <anonymous_script>:N header and caret for an uncaught error in eval code whose source isn't a literal, for every kind of error in the program's own code: a call of a non-function, a ReferenceError, a let read before it is set, a RangeError, a mixed BigInt, a stack overflow, and an Error, TypeError, RangeError or subclass the program makes, its stack read first or not; the caret under a throw statement that makes the error, under the expression for one V8 raises in it, under the error's creation in a rejection or an ES module's evaluation, under a throw later on the line otherwise; from -e, piped stdin, a timer, a rejection, an indirect eval, CommonJS files, including ones compiled as Function bodies (no eval in their source), with tabs and a throw before the error, ES module files and their timers, and a vm script (uncaught stderr shown without its frames, which include Node's internal ones)
